source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Log the entire incident, including all the actions taken as recorded in the incident report. This is very important, not just for the documentation but also for the legal defense of the company.
3. Use the OSHA log to record all recordable cases.
4. Do not rely on any records from the employer’s medical services or nurse attendant or the Safety Supervisor. 
   Your job is to capture and track all incidents that have the potential to impact the employee.
5. Contact the injured employee two or three weeks after the employee was discharged from the hospital. 
   It is mostly the monitoring center that is responsible for getting in touch with the injured employee after discharge.
6. Keep the employee’s phone number updated so you can track the employee’s condition.
